boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of North Florida
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Jacksonville food and activity destinations with publicly posted late hours; confirm hours before leaving.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Beach Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 13710 Beach Blvd, Jacksonville, FL 32224
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when you need a late food stop; the location posts service through 3 a.m. most nights and later on select nights.
cards.short_summary: A Beach Boulevard drive-thru with hours extending into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours until 3 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday, 5:30 a.m. Thursday, and 24 hours Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: 7 a.m.–3 a.m. Monday–Wednesday; 7 a.m.–5:30 a.m. Thursday; open 24 hours Friday–Saturday; 5:30 a.m.–3 a.m. Sunday.

cards.title: Taco Bell at Towne Center Parkway
cards.subtitle: 4466 Towne Center Pkwy, Jacksonville, FL 32246
cards.notes: Check the location page before going, then use its posted late drive-thru window for a practical stop near the Town Center area.
cards.short_summary: A Town Center-area Taco Bell whose locator lists late drive-thru service.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's Jacksonville locator lists the 4466 Towne Center Parkway restaurant as open until 5:30 a.m. and identifies it as a drive-thru location.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Jacksonville, FL
cards.access_notes: The official Jacksonville locator shows this restaurant open until 5:30 a.m.; verify day-specific hours on the location page before travel.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Atlantic Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 13160 Atlantic Blvd, Jacksonville, FL 32225
cards.notes: Plan this as a drive-thru pickup and verify the day; posted hours run to 3 a.m. or later throughout the week.
cards.short_summary: An Atlantic Boulevard Taco Bell with early-morning drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru service until 3 a.m. Monday–Wednesday and Sunday, 4 a.m. Thursday, and 5 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru closes at 3 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday, 4 a.m. Thursday, and 5 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dining room is listed closed.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on Beach Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 13799 Beach Blvd Unit 008C, Jacksonville, FL 32224
cards.notes: Place a carryout or delivery order before midnight and use the official location page to confirm the restaurant’s nightly service window.
cards.short_summary: A Beach Boulevard pizza location listing midnight carryout and delivery hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists restaurant hours of 10 a.m.–12 a.m. every day for its 13799 Beach Boulevard location.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours are posted as 10 a.m.–12 a.m. daily; the page notes delivery hours may vary.

cards.title: Pizza Hut at Beach Boulevard #20
cards.subtitle: 11233 Beach Blvd #20, Jacksonville, FL 32246
cards.notes: Use the location’s order options for a late pizza pickup; its official Jacksonville listing shows an after-midnight closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Beach Boulevard Pizza Hut listed open until 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut's official Jacksonville location directory lists the 11233 Beach Boulevard restaurant as open until 1 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The official city directory lists this location open until 1 a.m.; check its store page for day-specific service and delivery details.

cards.title: Whataburger on Southside Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 8325 Southside Blvd, Jacksonville, FL 32256
cards.notes: Choose dine-in, drive-thru, or delivery when you need a round-the-clock food option; curbside follows a shorter posted schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger lists 24-hour dine-in, drive-thru, and delivery service every day at 8325 Southside Boulevard.
cards.access_notes: Dine-in, drive-thru, and delivery are listed 24 hours daily; curbside is posted 7 a.m.–10 p.m. daily. Holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: Whataburger at Beach and Southside
cards.subtitle: 8840 Beach Blvd, Jacksonville, FL 32216
cards.notes: Use the 24-hour dine-in or drive-thru service for a late food stop, and note that curbside pickup ends earlier than the restaurant.
cards.short_summary: A Beach Boulevard Whataburger with 24-hour dine-in and drive-thru.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger lists 24-hour dine-in, drive-thru, and delivery service every day at 8840 Beach Boulevard.
cards.access_notes: Dine-in, drive-thru, and delivery are posted 24 hours daily; curbside is posted 6 a.m.–12 a.m. daily. Holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: KFC on Beach Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 10770 Beach Blvd, Jacksonville, FL 32246
cards.notes: Use carryout, delivery, or the drive-thru before midnight; the official KFC Jacksonville directory posts the same closing time each day.
cards.short_summary: A Beach Boulevard KFC with midnight service listed daily.
cards.evidence_claim: KFC's official Jacksonville directory lists the 10770 Beach Boulevard restaurant open from 10 a.m. to 12 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official directory hours are 10 a.m.–12 a.m. daily; services listed include carryout, delivery, no-contact delivery, and drive-thru.

cards.title: Beach Bowl Jacksonville
cards.subtitle: 818 Beach Blvd, Jacksonville, FL 32250
cards.notes: Reserve or check availability, then combine bowling with the venue’s food service; posted closing times extend past midnight on most nights.
cards.short_summary: A Jacksonville Beach bowling venue with a late-night food menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Beach Bowl lists hours until 1 a.m. Monday–Thursday, 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday, and 12 a.m. Sunday, and advertises a late-night menu.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: 11 a.m.–1 a.m. Monday–Thursday, 11 a.m.–2 a.m. Friday, 10 a.m.–2 a.m. Saturday, and 10 a.m.–12 a.m. Sunday.

cards.title: Alder & Oak at Jacksonville Beach
cards.subtitle: 131 1st Ave N Unit 101, Jacksonville Beach, FL 32250
cards.notes: Make a reservation or walk in for dinner, especially on Friday or Saturday when this restaurant posts an 11 p.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A wood-fired Aegean restaurant with later weekend dinner hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Alder & Oak lists Jacksonville Beach dinner hours until 11 p.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted Jacksonville Beach hours: 4–10 p.m. Monday–Thursday, 4–11 p.m. Friday, 11 a.m.–11 p.m. Saturday, and 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Sunday.
